description: Governed lineage manifest for Module 0 KPI/score/recommendation families. Single source of truth for the EvidenceDrawer Lineage tab: each family traces a product number from the raw Cotality share through silver lifts, UC scoring functions, and gold tables to the metric view the app reads. Kept consistent with sql/transformations/*, sql/uc_functions/*, and sql/metric_views/* — the live integration test (tests/integration/test_lineage_manifest_live.py) verifies every object here exists in Unity Catalog. A null catalog resolves to the deployed default catalog (MIP_DEFAULT_CATALOG).
